# Mixamo character and animation subset

This directory contains the curated Adobe Mixamo assets used by the Earth Core
character presentation. The base character is `X Bot`; animation FBX files are
downloaded for that same skeleton and imported as Humanoid clips by Unity.

Source: https://www.mixamo.com/

Only the clips required by the project are kept here. Root motion remains
disabled; gameplay movement is owned by `PlanetMotor`.
